en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large curved masonry dam with a roadway along the crest. A man in early 20th‑century clothing stands near the base of the structure. On the right side are terraced construction works, small buildings, and a forested hillside in the background. The printed caption in German at the top left reads "Talsperre Klingenberg i. Sa." and there is a handwritten red number in the top right corner.
